name: @spike/catalog-pack
description: The asset-catalog example's extension. A @spike/* workspace member only so pnpm installs its dependencies into its node_modules (the CI --filter='!@spike/*' skips it): mime-types for the handler and the workspace's @rayspec/platform for the entry. The workspace:* specifiers resolve nowhere else; build.mjs writes package.out-of-repo.json as the built extension's manifest and vendors the third-party dependencies next to it.
